4316-5078-6791-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

4694-4802-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-5315-7306.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

813-1269-2081.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield and allowing each opponent to return a creature from their graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Culling the Weak and Exhume from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2843-6495-6553.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2843-6495-6553.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2511-5931.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

851-4772-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Adrix and Nev and Doubling Season.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
851-4772-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

2021-2060-2265-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1263-4556-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4289-4885-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-4885-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-4885-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3821-5778-6884.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
3821-5778-6884.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Cast Aang by paying {3}{W} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, airbending the nontoken Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the second Aang trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1. Put the token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Aang's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Peregrine Drake from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.

2043-3621-5231.description:

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

80-1618-2149-2440.description:

Resolve Venture Forth.

80-1618-2149-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Zaffai. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

Cast Kirol either from your hand or the command zone by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

112-2631-6496.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-2631-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-2631-6496.description:
Cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany and exiling the original Alrund's Epiphany with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Alrund's Epiphany copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Alrund's Epiphany and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Alrund's Epiphany's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Alrund's Epiphany and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Alrund's Epiphany's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-2631-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Alrund's Epiphany is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Alrund's Epiphany is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.
